source_policy: Statistics use only fixed cohort cases.json and root canonical records; reviewer proposals, precomputed counts and source/execution outcomes are not reinterpreted.

definitions.denominator: 88 trajectories and 58 distinct cohort task names; missing factors only, excluding required factors already present in the base.

case_buckets.allExact: Every missing factor is Exact; empty lists satisfy this universally and are separately listed.
case_buckets.allKnown: Every missing factor is Exact/Related and at least one is Related; excludes allExact to keep the buckets mutually exclusive.
case_buckets.hasAbsent: At least one Absent and no null factor.
case_buckets.unresolved: At least one explicit null provenance, regardless of other factors; no oracle/execution uncertainty is inferred into this bucket.

definitions.task_buckets: Apply the same precedence to all missing factors pooled over trajectories of that task. Case-group task counts otherwise count membership and may overlap across case buckets.
definitions.historical_witness: Only the explicit primary complete_assertion_witness flag; printed effects, implicit relations, P/R results and additional prose are not reclassified. Explicit other_task_behavior_complete_assertion_witness is reported separately.
definitions.cardinality: Reported construction counts, not global or validated minima. The four legacy fields are mapped explicitly; null/absent fields stay unknown. Nested reviewer/source proposals, list lengths, conditional components and record-edit counts are not substitutes.
definitions.S085_fragment_scope: transferred_semantic_fragments; two record edits are not counted as two semantic fragments.
